title: Free hybrid overlay-removal pipeline: Gemini vision detect + local inpaint
description: Gemini removed free-tier access for all image-generation/editing models (gemini-2.5-flash-image now costs ~$0.039/image, confirmed via ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing on 2026-08-17). Vision/text input on gemini-2.5-flash and gemini-3.1-flash(-lite) is still free of charge. User chose to replace the paid image-edit call with a free hybrid: a free Gemini vision call locates the overlay/watermark region (bbox or mask), then a local CPU inpainting model (same ONNX-on-CPU pattern as src/image_postprocess.py's Real-ESRGAN SR) paints it out. Removes billing/spend-cap dependency entirely for the core watermark-removal feature.
acceptance_criteria: Bot removes overlays/watermarks from user images using zero Gemini image-generation spend: only free-tier Gemini vision calls plus local CPU inpainting. Falls back gracefully if local model or detection fails. Docs (AGENTS.md/README) no longer claim gemini-2.5-flash-image is free.
close_reason: Implemented: src/overlay_detect.py (free Gemini vision bbox detection) + src/local_inpaint.py (local MI-GAN ONNX inpaint) wired into gemini_engine.remove_overlays_gemini. Verified end-to-end on the production VPS incl. real memory profiling (chose MI-GAN over LaMa: ~470MB vs ~490MB+ RSS, but MI-GAN scales flat with crop size while LaMa is fixed-512 fp32; MI-GAN also has simpler uint8 I/O). Old paid path kept as remove_overlays_gemini_paid. Docs (AGENTS.md/README/.env.example/CLI script docstring) updated to drop stale free-tier claims about gemini-2.5-flash-image.
